pr_title: Fix IPGlobalProperties.DomainName to return string.Empty when domain name is not set
pr_body:
Fixes #104882

Fix `IPGlobalProperties.DomainName` to return `string.Empty` instead of `"(none)"` on Linux.

* **HostInformationPal.Unix.cs**
  - Check if the domain name is `"(none)"` in `GetDomainName()`.
  - Return `string.Empty` if the domain name is `"(none)"`.

* **Interop.GetDomainName.cs**
  - Handle the case where the domain name is not set in `GetDomainName()`.
  - Return `string.Empty` if the domain name is `"(none)"`.

* **IPGlobalPropertiesTest.cs**
  - Add a test to verify that `IPGlobalProperties.DomainName` returns `string.Empty` when the domain name is not set.

issue_context.title: `IPGlobalProperties.DomainName` returns `"(none)"` on Linux
issue_context.body: ### Description as per [Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.net.networkinformation.ipglobalproperties.domainname?view=net-8.0), the property should either return the actual domain name or `string.Empty`. ### Reproduction Steps - have a Linux install, where the domain is missing(?) - use eg. `pwsh` - run `[System.Net.NetworkInformation.IPGlobalProperties]::GetIPGlobalProperties().DomainName` ### Expected behavior either return the actual domain name or `string.Empty` ### Actual behavior returns `"(none)"` ### Regression? (we're using C# on Linux for the first time here, so no idea) ### Known Workarounds - `pwsh` - `$h = [System.Net.DNS]::GetHostname()` - `[System.Net.DNS]::GetHostEntry($h).HostName` - returns equivalent to `BUILD-SERVER-LX.company.local` But this approach might be unreliable if the DNS is not reachable, or perhaps misconfigured(?) ### Configuration Local: - WSL-Ubuntu - `Linux MY-WORK-PC-123 4.4.0-19041-Microsoft #4355-Microsoft Thu Apr 12 17:37:00 PST 2024 x86_64 x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linux` - `/etc/hosts` contains a line a la `127.0.1.1 MY-WORK-PC-123.company.local MY-WORK-PC-123` (actual names replaced) - tests (via VS-WSL) are passing Build Server: - `Linux BUILD-SERVER-LX 5.15.0-113-generic #123-Ubuntu SMP Mon Jun 10 08:16:17 UTC 2024 x86_64 x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linux` - no such hosts line - tests fail, as the FQDN determined is `"BUILD-SERVER-LX.(none)"`, which was (with additional strings) passed to `new Uri(...)` This issue was caught by our tests (net6.0), but `[Environment]::Version` (`pwsh`) shows 8.0.6 (ob both machines) and it experiences the same behavior (build server) Not sure if C# gets the information from the hosts file, just something i noticed. WSL re-creates the file upon restart, and on the build server I currently do not have sufficient permissions to change the host file. ### Other information _No response_

This calls `getdomainname` under the cover e.g. this is _not_ DNS domain name. However the documentation is clear about empty string and we return `null` on Linux. So we should ether update the code to fix the nullability annotation and documentation. I feel former would be easier and perhaps more appropriate.
